title: trichilia moschata subsp. matudae
intro: Trichilia moschata subsp. matudae, commonly known as Mexican soursop, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. It has been traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Mexican soursop include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and pain, and exerting anti-cancer and anti-diabetic effects. Additionally, the plant's bioactive compounds may also exhibit immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
